content: What was the original reason we went with SSE instead of WebSocket?

Request/response tool calls dominate the traffic pattern, so stateless HTTP intermediaries buy us proxy-friendliness and easier debugging without losing anything essential. Anthropic's mod_mcp and aiohttp both handle SSE natively — low maintenance cost. We reserved WebSocket for the one or two endpoints that would genuinely benefit from push-style events.
OK, dropping it into the design doc.
